scope: Actual local Parquet column reads and subsequent recorded measurements at checkpoint+60 seconds; not live data collection. Initial broad detection cost is excluded from marginal follow-up accounting.
limitations: Static one-hop and evidence-frontier coincide when no recorded topology exists; no graph advantage claimed.
One file read per nonempty strategy; fewer columns are not fewer AWS API calls.
table_memory_bytes is an in-memory data-volume proxy, not cloud billing or disk bytes read.
Uniform/random selections can miss a cause; abstention is included in accuracy denominators.
No anomaly labels or root causes are used for resource selection.
